facts.text: The resort is in the historical district of Majorda in South Goa.
facts.excerpt: in the historical district of Majorda in South Goa.

facts.text: Gonsua Beach is 500 meters from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Known for its clean and gorgeous white sands, Gonsua Beach is only 500 meters from the resort.

facts.text: The architecture is contemporary Goan, using local materials including red laterite stone and teak.
facts.excerpt: Contemporary Goan architecture combines with local materials, including red laterite stone and teak

facts.text: The resort has high-pitched roofs, wide verandas and tranquil courtyards.
facts.excerpt: High-pitched roofs, wide verandas and tranquil courtyards

facts.text: All rooms have a balcony with views of the pool, gardens or paddy fields.
facts.excerpt: all of which feature a balcony for taking in views of the pool, lush gardens or paddy fields.

facts.text: The infinity pool has partially submerged recliners and overlooks rice paddies and bamboo stands.
facts.excerpt: an infinity pool with partially submerged recliners overlooking rice paddies and bamboo stands

facts.text: The Diwa Club is a pet-friendly resort within a resort inside Alila Diwa Goa.
facts.excerpt: The Diwa Club is a pet-friendly resort within a resort, nestled within Alila Diwa Goa.

facts.text: The Diwa Club has its own pool with an open-air jetted tub.
facts.excerpt: the Diwa Club boasts its pool with an open-air ‘jetted tub’.

facts.text: Spa Alila offers a blend of Asian, Western and Ayurvedic treatments.
facts.excerpt: We offer a unique blend of Asian, Western and Ayurvedic treatments with oils made using fresh, natural and high-quality ingredients.

facts.text: The Yoga Studio overlooks lush greenery.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in tranquility at our Yoga Studio, overlooking lush greenery for a truly revitalizing experience.

facts.text: Play Alila is the resort's kids' club, with activities and curated experiences for kids 12 and under.
facts.excerpt: offers a range of activities and curated experiences, ideal for kids 12 and under.

facts.text: The Teen Zone, next to Play Alila, has table tennis, foosball, carrom, chess and scrabble.
facts.excerpt: Adjacent to Play Alila is the Teen Zone, a chill-out space for teenagers and their families to relax over games of table tennis, foosball, carrom, chess, and scrabble.

facts.text: The Alila Mini-Theatre has daily movie screenings.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a movie at the Alila​ Mini-Theatre, where daily screenings

facts.text: Spice Studio serves the coastal cuisines of Kerala, Karnataka and Goa and is built around a banyan tree.
facts.excerpt: Celebrate the deep flavors and aromas of the kitchens of Kerala, Karnataka and Goa at Spice Studio, built around a majestic Banyan tree.

facts.text: An Alila Moment takes guests on a walk from the resort to a village bakery to learn Goan breadmaking.
facts.excerpt: Walk from the resort to the village bakery while learning about Goa’s breadmaking legacy and Portuguese culinary imprint.

facts.text: An Alila Moment tours a working feni distillery with maker Mr. Hansel.
facts.excerpt: Tour the working distillery with Mr. Hansel, observing each step of the process from harvest to fermentation to bottling.

facts.text: A sound healing session uses two sets of Himalayan singing bowls.
facts.excerpt: Two sets of Himalayan singing bowls create tonal layers that resonate through your body

facts.text: Courtyard Bar is a speakeasy-inspired, retro-themed evening cocktail bar overlooking the courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Courtyard Bar is a speakeasy inspired retro-themed evening cocktail bar overlooking the courtyard with both indoor and outdoor seating.

facts.text: Open-sided, high-ceilinged public spaces are cooled by reflecting pools and fountains.
facts.excerpt: The public rooms and corridors, open-sided and high-ceilinged, draw in the lush surroundings, which are cooled by reflecting pools and fountains.

facts.text: Loft Rooms are furnished in a contemporary wooden loft style with a touch of Goan tradition.
facts.excerpt: Furnished in a contemporary wooden loft style with a touch of Goan tradition

facts.text: Ground-level Family Terrace Rooms open onto a private garden patio.
facts.excerpt: Each room opens out onto an outdoor garden patio, where one can sit and relax in privacy.
